    LDA save_end_lo,Y               \ the walk ends when v_ptr + 8 is the block's end

    SBC #8
    STA rb_end

    DEY

    STA rb_part2 + 2
    DEY
    LDA (v_ptr),Y

    ORA rb_part2 + 1,X

    STA v_ptr                       \ v_ptr is dead here: set to the result below
candidates.new:
STY rb_index
IF SKY_MODE = 0
    CLC
ENDIF
    LDX #2                          \ part 3, then part 2: from its start to rb_end
    LDA save_end_lo,Y               \ the walk ends when v_ptr + 8 is the block's end (C = 0 from
    ADC #&F8                        \ sky_take_off's clear; - 8 as + &F8, C = no borrow)
    STA rb_end
    LDA save_end_hi,Y
    ADC #&FF                        \ - 1 + C
    STA rb_end + 1
    LDA save_start_lo,Y             \ the header: where parts 2 and 3 start
    STA v_ptr
    LDA save_start_hi,Y
    STA v_ptr + 1
    LDA (v_ptr)                     \ the four bytes, unrolled (65C02 opcode)
    STA rb_part2
    LDY #1
    LDA (v_ptr),Y
    STA rb_part2 + 1
    INY
    LDA (v_ptr),Y
    STA rb_part2 + 2
    INY
    LDA (v_ptr),Y
    STA rb_part2 + 3
    ORA rb_part2 + 2                \ part 3's test, here: A = its two bytes
    BNE rbg_part_here               \ there: straight in, X = 2
    LDX #0                          \ none: on to part 2 (what no_part's DEX, DEX and BPL do)
.each_part
    LDA rb_part2,X
    ORA rb_part2 + 1,X
    BEQ no_part
.rbg_part_here
    LDY rb_index                    \ v_ptr = its start - 8
    LDA save_start_lo,Y
    CLC
    ADC rb_part2,X
    STA v_ptr                       \ v_ptr is dead here: set to the result below
candidates.summary: Fuse part 3's presence test into the header copy and skip the loop's first test; when part 3 is absent go straight to part 2 with X = 0 (no DEX, DEX, BPL), and rb_end's 16-bit subtract as ADC #&F8 / ADC #&FF on the carry restore_block is entered with (SEC dropped; CLC added for SKY_HELI=0 builds). Overlaps B and C (alternatives; best first). Measured on scratch builds (bench build, pcprof as the gate): render 23430 -> 23416 (seed 1, -14) and 28406 -> 28391 (RIGHT, -15).
candidates.equivalence: rb_end: lo - 8 = lo + &F8 with C = 0 (carry out = no borrow); hi - borrow = hi + &FF + carry-out: same bytes. C = 0 on entry in SKY_MODE: restore_block's only caller is take_off, which reaches it only via sky_take_off's CLC (the 'no' path; the SEC path branches to sky_off); SKY_MODE = 0 builds get an explicit CLC. Stores to v_ptr, v_ptr+1, rb_end(+1), rb_index and rb_part2..+3 are the same values (bytes 0-3 copied in the order 0,1,2,3 not 3,2,1,0: no overlap or side effect, the block is only read). X = 2 is set before the test (X is not used in between). Part 3 test: A = byte 3 OR byte 2 (what LDA rb_part2,X / ORA rb_part2+1,X computes for X = 2 once those are stored). Present: BNE to rbg_part_here, same state as the old fall-through (X = 2, Y reloaded from rb_index, C unknown, CLC follows). Absent: LDX #0 then falls into each_part: the same state as the old no_part's DEX, DEX, BPL (X = 0; A, Y, flags dead: each_part's LDA overwrites A, Y is reloaded from rb_index, nothing reads the flags). Second iterations (BPL each_part from outside the window) enter at each_part with X = 0 exactly as before; no_part is branched to unchanged; every label outside (each_part, no_part) keeps its meaning. The old LDY #3/DEY copy order and the new LDY #1/INY order both end with Y dead (reloaded at rbg_part_here, and in no_part's successor at .LDY rb_index).
candidates.relies_on: Page crossings (bench build listing, 2026-10-22): the window grows by 5 bytes (7 in SKY_HELI=0 builds: +6), shifting all later bank 4 code. Branches whose crossing changes: BEQ gathered (old &9EFD, taken and crossing: 2,914 cycles seed 1) stops crossing (a gain); BEQ out in the sky/take-off area (&A2F7, 456 cycles) starts crossing (a small loss); wa_rows_guess,X (&A0F5, 64 bytes: indexes 11+ cross now, 6+ after, X = the screen offset's high byte 0..63, ~5 executions a pass) loses ~0.4 cycles a pass. The measured total was a net gain: -14 and -15. restore_block's own branches: BNE rbg_part_here (8 bytes forward) and BEQ no_part stay in-page or are short; hot reads in the window are zero page or REN_BASE tables (&BAxx/&BBxx), which do not move. Needs C = 0 on entry (above) and the 65C02 (BNE/LDX are NMOS ops; ORA zp, LDA (zp) as before).

candidates.equivalence: As A without the rb_end change: part 3 test = byte 3 OR byte 2 in A after the copy (bytes stored in the same zero-page cells as before); present path enters the body with X = 2 as the fall-through did; absent path sets X = 0, the state no_part's DEX, DEX with BPL gives, and falls into each_part's part 2 test. The loop's later passes (BPL each_part from outside) are unchanged.
